title: Attain the static connector rank bound and audit its obstruction
body:
This **construction and separate proof audit** shows that the connector rank/signature cut is sharp, even for square-zero thin queries. Over every finite field of characteristic two, the construction has `g=2q^(dh)-1` leaves, total thin rank `2d+2h`, and at most two leaves per row or column signature. **Complete kappa is unchanged.**

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/67f07448eec5ad8d84bdf96b46981ac0b893592f/research/one-sided-connector-audit/PROOF.md), [exact evidence](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/67f07448eec5ad8d84bdf96b46981ac0b893592f/research/one-sided-connector-audit/RESULT.json), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/67f07448eec5ad8d84bdf96b46981ac0b893592f/research/one-sided-connector-audit/SOURCES.json), [validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/67f07448eec5ad8d84bdf96b46981ac0b893592f/research/one-sided-connector-audit/VALIDATION.md).

The construction supplies explicit static maps for both targets in [PR #5673](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5673): **31 leaves with five rank-two queries**, and **127 leaves with ten rank-one queries**. Every map has square zero and their sum is the required K. These maps are not chronological words. They show that another exclusion of these targets must use an additional condition, such as chronology or the full endpoint.

A separate implementation and written audit confirm the source's mixed-coefficient restriction and prefix determinant proof under its full-stage contract. The checker imports no source code or finite certificate. It checks 19,440 ordered flag words, 72 literal words with noncommuting flags and external stages, 432 extracted blocks, formal polynomial determinants, and six complete static matrix fixtures including F4. Twelve damaged constructions are rejected.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/one-sided-connector-audit
```

Expected: `PASS_ONE_SIDED_AUDIT_AND_STATIC_SHARPNESS` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. Python3.12 and the standard library suffice. Normal and optimized registered runs, committed-byte and archive checks, read-only Git-free optimized replay with empty PATH, and actual retained-source corruption rejection pass. No complete caller, native lift, physical invoice, new tariff, proof-assistant or independent human acceptance follows. Hosted CI is pending at publication. Full-history preflight was not run in the shallow checkout; immediate source ancestry and bytes were checked.

Base and refreshed main: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`, priority7, selected conditional kappa `.00310045`. Contribution head: `67f07448eec5ad8d84bdf96b46981ac0b893592f`. The retained [source proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c10f75f09e41803ae8efe478331a7509b7379b2f/research/crossed-connector-caller/PROOF.md) is unchanged. It supplies the obstruction, lower bounds, targets and retained credit to Cinna Davis and the P104/helper/compiler line. The static sharpness construction and separate implementation are new here. This is a separate audit by the same assistant family, not independent human review.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0. [Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5593#discussioncomment-19188781).
